title: Owner App Activity Report — implementation review
lede: A restrained report for answering who has used the app, which clients they have used, and whether their iOS build is current. Matched browser captures remain pending authenticated deployment proof.

stats.n: Owner allowlist plus ADMIN route requirement
OS, release channel, app-open and last-seen timestamps
Only when the latest iOS target is configured

changesNote: The surface is intentionally narrow: it is a current client-presence report for owner support and adoption decisions, not a replay or broad behavioral analytics dashboard.

changes.h: Generic usage counts became named client context
changes.was: Aggregate usage could show activity volume, but not which user, device, OS, build, or distribution channel was behind it.
changes.now: Each visible roster user has an app-use state and last launch, plus every reported iOS/web installation with coarse device identity, OS version, marketing version, build, release channel, first/last seen, and last opened timestamps.

changes.h: Build freshness became an explicit support signal
changes.was: A developer had to infer whether a client was stale from separate release and user information.
changes.now: The report compares iOS builds to configured IOS_LATEST_APP_VERSION / IOS_LATEST_APP_BUILD and labels them Latest, Stale, Newer, or Compare unavailable.

changes.h: The report stays private and privacy-light
changes.was: A role-only report would expose named adoption detail too broadly, and hardware identifiers could become a fingerprinting surface.
changes.now: The route is owner-allowlisted, hidden roster users are excluded, the installation key is HMAC-scoped server-side, and only coarse device metadata is retained.

verification: 83 focused tests across web/report and native/API contracts pass.
Web build: npm run build:app passes and includes the new Settings page and API route.
Native build: Wisconsin builds for the available iPhone 16 Pro / iOS 26.5 simulator destination.
Browser capture: not completed; the local route redirects to sign-in without an authenticated session, and the deployed host returns Page not found because this slice is not deployed yet.
notes: Apply migration 0129_app_activity_report and configure the owner allowlist plus the latest iOS build environment variables.
Capture the authenticated owner view and role-only denial in the deployed app.
Verify TestFlight and App Store rows on real signed builds; the channel classifier is intentionally best effort and can report Unknown when the receipt signal is unavailable.
